title: A hyper-realistic 8K photograph of a bea
prompt:
A hyper-realistic 8K photograph of a beautiful East Asian woman , sitting on the floor against a white textured wall. Dark brown hair in a messy half-up ponytail, face-framing strands, a few loose pieces across the cheek. Fair realistic skin with visible pores and a soft sheen, brown eyes, defined brows, glossy muted rose lips. Layered silver chain necklaces, one with a small heart pendant.

She wears a black strap bandeau of four horizontal bands with white plastic buckles. White lettering reads ITOUCH, Dont, and look at me, with a small IT circle on the right band. A black leather jacket is held open at both sides. Black high-waist trousers with a hanging zipper pull at the fly.

Lighting: soft daylight from camera-left, wrapping the right cheek, collarbones and the upper curve of the bust. Thin highlights on the leather and the buckle edges; gentle penumbra between the straps. Clean wall bounce fill. Shot on an 85mm f/2, shallow depth of field, photorealistic skin, peach fuzz, leather and webbing micro-texture, fashion editorial look.
